name: White Mage
summary: A white mage is an arcanist touched by a divine power and gifted with the ability to heal others.

features.name: Spontaneous Healing (Su)
features.summary: At 1st level, a white mage can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to use one of her spell slots to cast a cure spell (any spell with “cure” in its name) from the cleric spell list as if it were on her spell list and prepared. The spell must be of a level the arcanist can cast. At 10th level, the white mage can expend 5 points from her arcane reservoir and a spell slot of at least 5th level to cast breath of life . This ability replaces the arcanist exploits gained at 1st and 9th levels.

features.name: Greater Exploit
features.summary: At 11th level, a white mage can select the following greater exploit. Fast Healing (Su) : A white mage can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir and expend a spell slot of at least 2nd level to grant her allies the fast healing ability. Allies within 30 feet gain fast healing ( Bestiary 300) equal to 1/2 the level of the spell slot sacrificed. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the arcanist’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression, on-demand Cleric cure and breath of life casting, legal Fast Healing greater-exploit selection, spell-slot and arcane-reservoir costs, scaling fast healing, Charisma-based duration, encounter tracking, and save/load persistence are automated.
